tags.name: Consumer Digital Payment (HyperPay)
tags.description: Israeli HyperPay checkout after placing an order with `payment_method: digital_payment`. App flow: **place order** → **generate payment link** → open `redirect_link` (302 to HyperPay) → user pays → backend **success/failed/notify** callbacks mark the order paid and redirect to your `callback` URL with `flag` + `token`.

post.summary: Create HyperPay checkout URL for an unpaid order
post.description:
Requires a logged-in **registered** customer (guest JWT is rejected).

Creates or reuses a row in `payment_requests` and returns a URL on **this backend** (`/payment/hyperpay/pay?payment_id=…`). Opening that URL redirects the browser to HyperPay.

Typical `payment_method` value from the PHP app: `hyper_pay`.

`callback` is your app deep link or web URL; after payment the user is sent back with `flag=success|fail` and a base64 `token` (same idea as legacy PHP).

404.description: Order not found or already paid

example.msg: Order not found or already paid

servers.description: Same backend host as the API (no /api prefix). Set env API_PUBLIC_URL to this host for HyperPay Success/Error URLs.

get.description:
Public endpoint. Validates unpaid `payment_requests` row, signs request with HyperPay, responds **302** to `https://pay.hyp.co.il/p/…`.

Mobile apps usually receive this URL as `redirect_link` from generate-payment-link.

parameters.name: payment_id
parameters.description: Payment request id from generate-payment-link flow

302.description: Redirect to HyperPay hosted payment page

404.description: Unknown or already paid payment request

get.description: HyperPay redirects the user's browser here after payment. Verifies signature, marks payment paid, runs order hook, then redirects to the app `callback` or shows a simple HTML success page.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description: HyperPay order id (often same as payment_id)

200.description: HTML success or connectivity test OK

302.description: Redirect to app/web callback with flag=success

402.description: Payment failed validation — HTML fail page or callback with flag=fail

post.description: Same handler as GET; HyperPay may POST form fields.

get.description: User cancelled or payment failed. Runs failure hook and redirects to callback with `flag=fail` when configured.

200.description: HTML fail page or connectivity test OK

servers.description: Register this URL in the HyperPay merchant portal (server-to-server)

get.description: Webhook for HyperPay. Register `{API_PUBLIC_URL}/payment/hyperpay/notify` in the HYP portal. Idempotent: safe to retry.

400.description: Missing Order or invalid signature on success

order_id.description: Unpaid order id belonging to the logged-in user

payment_method.description: Gateway key stored on payment_requests (PHP uses hyper_pay / hypay after pay)

callback.description: App deep link or web URL for final redirect after HyperPay

redirect_link.description: Backend URL that 302s to HyperPay — open in WebView/browser
